_meta.description: SEDA Registered PV Service Provider (RPVSP) directory used by SuriaSnap.
_meta.source: Full company list transcribed from SEDA's public RPVSP listing at https://services.seda.gov.my/spqp/listing (435 companies). The listing publishes company names only in this export, so hq_state/city/website/phone are present only for the entries SuriaSnap had already verified from the providers' own public sites; every other entry carries name only and is deliberately left null rather than guessed.
notes: Companies previously curated but NOT present in the SEDA listing were removed: Sunview Group, Trexon Energy, Proksi Solar, Guide Solar. The registry is authoritative.
website is null where the provider's domain no longer resolves (Pekat, GSPARX, Cypark) or where SuriaSnap has no verified URL. Never fabricate one.
whatsapp is present only for numbers verified by the SuriaSnap team.
priority_states pins an installer to rank 1 for the listed states (commercial placement).
_meta.disclaimer: Always confirm a provider's current SEDA registration on the official directory before signing any contract.
